subject.title: refactor(signal): remove global ingress test hook

question: Should this protected Signal refactor be accepted after the contributor supplies current-head proof that runtime queue ownership is unchanged and the removed test global is no longer created?
rationale: The remaining gate is evidence for an internal runtime/test-boundary change on a PR carrying a protected maintainer label; that acceptance judgment should not be automated.

options.title: Request refreshed runtime proof
options.body: Require redacted output from the current head showing normal runtime-owned queue startup plus a check that importing the Signal test support does not register the former global symbol.

options.title: Accept the test-only evidence
options.body: A Signal owner may accept the existing focused test suite and static checks if they consider the runtime invariant adequately covered.

recommendation.title: Request refreshed runtime proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted output from the current head showing normal runtime-owned queue startup plus a check that importing the Signal test support does not register the former global symbol.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the related durable-ingress implementation and are the assigned author of the focused refactor.
